title: Code 100% AI, art and music 100% human: one evening in the cozy town we're building
author: Shot-Abies-7822
selftext:
Hi all, I hope it's ok to share this here. If not, mods, please just remove it 🙏

I'm Gerhard, a founder and game designer in Helsinki. Over the last few months, my co-founder Justin and I have been building Elfen Town (think Discord meets Stardew Valley) for our own community, Eleven Dunbar. WhatsApp and Discord never felt like a real home for us. The best conversations always happened by accident, when you walk past someone and end up talking for an hour. So we built a town where that can happen, with spatial audio and video chat.

The code is written with AI (Claude). All the art and music in Elfen Town is made by hand. It was important to us that everything members touch directly is made by hand. If we don't feel a connection to the art or the music ourselves, we can't expect anyone else to feel anything either.

I'd also love to see an AI game dev guild (=community) in there: a place to show WIP, swap workflows and run devlog evenings by the fire.

We're looking for:

1) curious individuals who want to join the Elfeneers, our early-adopter guild

2) community leaders who want to test and experience a new way of building an online community that feels refreshingly human (no need to bring your community yet, try it out yourself first)

If you'd like to try it, apply here: [https://elfen.town/](https://elfen.town/) (click "join early access", the application takes less than 2 minutes)

Happy to answer anything about how we split the work between AI and us, and what worked and what didn't.

Where do you draw the line between AI and by hand in your own game?

comments.author: Elder_Realm
comments.body:
I love the art direction you have gone with.  
In terms of it being a social mmo, how are you planning to do moderation? I have always wondered how people handle stuff like that with online-discussion-things where you can't 100% prevent people from harassment or inappropriate/unwanted behaviour.

replies.author: Shot-Abies-7822
replies.body: 100% it is on our list of things to do, plus many other surprises hidden in the world. would you like to get early access and bring your ideas to the table? :)
